C0548.title: “Return Queen” Arrested for Four-Year Return Fraud via Swapping Old Clothes
C0548.summary: A woman dubbed the “Return Queen” carried out a return fraud scheme over four years by swapping purchased items with old clothes. She once ordered 121 spring and summer tops from three online stores in a single day, returned them all with old clothes swapped in, and obtained a platform-advanced refund of 21,680 yuan. To evade system detection, she stuffed thin paper sheets into the return packages

references.title: Freeloading for Four Years! 'Return Sister' Detained, Threw a Tantrum at Arrest Scene, Threatened to Use Connections
